svg.title: AREA 17
svg.desc: Enter left, leave right. The three-player group takes 1, 3, 5, 7; the solo takes 2, 4, 6, 8. Hold each pad until the other group crosses. Step 7 frees the solo; step 8 lets the three-player group rejoin. Find the dark-room false wall after warping. Once clear, three cross it and wait at the pistons. The fourth player starts the timer; it is too short to let that player catch up without help. Leave one player on the far-side pad to raise the center piston; depart only after the timer runner crosses.
